title: Casa Al Mare | Loaded Designer Home| Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Experience Casa Al Mare, a cozy retreat on 30A with a private pool. Ideal for a relaxing and comfortable vacation.
description_expanded: Welcome to your dream beach vacation in the heart of Seagrove Beach! This spacious 5-bedroom, 6-bath coastal home is packed with everything you need for the perfect 30A getaway - just 2 minutes to Eastern Lake Beach Access and a 1-minute bike ride to Greenway Station for shopping, dining, and coffee! What You'll Love: • 2-minute bike ride to the beach • LSV (golf cart) and Taxi bikes included for easy exploring • Private pool with sun loungers & outdoor seating • Gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances • Room for the whole crew - perfect for families and groups • Prime location close to Seaside, WaterSound, WaterColor and all the best of 30A while offering a quiet street to enjoy your vacation experience Relax in the open-concept living area, cook in the chef's kitchen, or soak up the sun by your private pool. Whether you're heading to the beach, biking to brunch, or enjoying a sunset cruise down 30A, this home is your perfect base. Casa Al Mare Features - Private Pool and fenced-in backyard. Pool can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April - Access to a 6-seater LSV (golf cart) and 6 Taxi Bikes to explore 30A (must sign a waiver for access) - 2-minute bike ride or LSV drive to Eastern Lake Beach Access - 4-minute LSV drive or bike ride to Walton Dunes Beach Access. Beach service available at this location - 1-minute LSV drive or bike ride to Greenway Station with upscale shopping and dining, including Free People, Turbo Coffee, Local Cantina, and Canopy Road Café - 3-minute LSV drive or bike ride to Old Florida Fish House, Beachy Beach Coffee Co, and Buddy's Seafood Market 30A - 2-minute LSV or bike ride to the Eastern Lake Boat Launch. This is the perfect spot to explore a rare coastal dune lake that flows into the Gulf. Kayak and Paddleboard rentals available for delivery by La Dolce Vita. Fishing licenses can be purchased at nearby Yellowfin Ocean Sports, only 3 minutes from the home - 9-minute drive to the WaterColor Publix. Curbside pickup and delivery available through InstaCart - 5 well-appointed bedrooms with cotton bedding and 6 full baths with bath amenities and cotton towels provided - 1st Floor Main living area with a plush sectional sofa, Smart TV, and wet bar featuring a mini-refrigerator - Gourmet kitchen with high-end Italian appliances, a kitchen island with built-in charging stations, and a coffee brew station with a drip and kCup coffee maker - Dining table for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - Covered patio next to the pool plus a sundeck with lounge seating - Outdoor Grill with built-in gas supply - Outdoor shower near the pool - Cable, WIFI, and Smart TVs throughout the home - 2nd Floor Laundry room with washer and dryer - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles (garage access not available) - Concierge services available including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, catered beach bonfires, chartered cruises in the Gulf, and more - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Book now and make unforgettable memories in Seagrove Beach!
rooms_guidance: 3rd Floor King Suite | “Ocean Blue”, Smart TV, ensuite bath with a tub and walk-in shower, wet bar with Keurig and mini-refrigerator
2nd Floor King Suite | “The Gold Room”, Smart TV, ensuite bath with a large walk-in shower
2nd Floor Queen Suite | “The Sage Room”, SmartTV, ensuite bath with a combo shower/tub
2nd Floor Guest Room | “The Coral Room”, sleeps 2 in a Queen bed, SmartTV, hallway access to the adjacent full bath with a walk-in shower
2nd Floor Bunk Room | Sleeps up to 4 in two Twin over Twin Bunks, TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
